history.title: Our History
history.p1: MAHAD Al-TOWHEED was founded with a clear vision to serve the community by providing outstanding education that blends modern academics with strong Islamic values.
history.p2: What began as a modest community initiative has grown into a leading educational institution, serving hundreds of students annually and producing graduates who positively shape society.

founder.title: Founder's Vision
founder.quote: Education is the foundation of every great society. When we invest in a child's mind and character, we invest in the future of our entire community.
founder.name: Founder of MAHAD Al-TOWHEED

timeline.title: Our Journey
timeline.subtitle: Key milestones that shaped our institution.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.desc: MAHAD Al-TOWHEED was established to address the educational needs of the local community.

milestones.title: First Graduation
milestones.desc: Our first class of students completed their primary education with exceptional results.

milestones.title: New Campus
milestones.desc: Expanded to a larger facility with modern classrooms, a library, and science labs.

milestones.title: Religious Program Launch
milestones.desc: Introduced a comprehensive religious education curriculum from Grade 1 through Grade 12.

milestones.title: International Partnerships
milestones.desc: Formed partnerships with global charities and NGOs to support student scholarships.

milestones.title: 500+ Students
milestones.desc: Now serving over 500 students across academic and religious programs.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe in nurturing both the intellect and the soul. Our approach combines rigorous academic standards with moral and spiritual development, ensuring every student grows into a knowledgeable, ethical, and compassionate member of society.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be a beacon of educational excellence and moral leadership, recognized for producing graduates who transform their communities through knowledge, integrity, and service.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To provide accessible, high-quality academic and religious education that empowers students with the knowledge, skills, and ethical values needed to become leaders in their communities.

items.title: Integrity
items.desc: We uphold the highest ethical standards in everything we do.

items.title: Compassion
items.desc: We serve our students and community with kindness and empathy.

items.title: Excellence
items.desc: We strive for the highest standards in teaching and learning.

items.title: Community
items.desc: We believe in giving back and strengthening the bonds of society.

intro.title: Welcome to MAHAD Al-TOWHEED
intro.subtitle: A place where academic excellence meets moral foundation.
intro.p1: Founded with a vision to serve our community, MAHAD Al-TOWHEED provides comprehensive education from Kindergarten through Grade 10, alongside a dedicated religious education program from Grade 1 through Grade 12.
intro.p2: We believe every child deserves access to quality education that nurtures both the mind and the spirit. Our dedicated teachers, modern facilities, and values-driven curriculum create an environment where students thrive.
intro.p3: As a non-profit institution, we rely on the generosity of donors and partners to continue our mission. Your support directly impacts the lives of children who would otherwise be left behind.

missionCards.valuesText: Integrity, Compassion, Excellence, Community Service, and Spiritual Growth form the core of everything we teach and practice at MAHAD Al-TOWHEED.
